ModMetaData.name: GateRim SG-1
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
GateRim SG-1 brings the Stargate SG-1 universe to RimWorld.
Current development scope: - Inheritable Jaffa lineage genes - Prim'ta Hediff prototype for an implanted immature symbiote - Goa'uld host xenotype prototype - Free Goa'uld symbiote pawn prototype - Recent Goa'uld implantation Hediff prototype - French translations for stabilized content - Player wiki maintained in parallel - Forced implantation, ritual implantation and host transfer planned next
Biotech is required for xenotype support. This is an early development version.
